description: Open a support ticket for staff, only after the help articles (search_help, or search_knowledge on the account endpoint) did not solve the problem or the customer asks for a person. name is required; contact (phone or email) is optional. Returns a reference and, for anonymous callers, a one-time access_code: give both to the customer exactly as returned. Limited per caller; do not retry the same ticket.
name: contact_support
title: Buka tiket ke staf
